outcome_summary: Delivered two complementary dialogue-extraction tools for LangGraph agent chunk JSONL files: a stdlib-only CLI script (`scripts/extract-dialogue.js`) and a GUI "Text Only" tab backed by a new `renderChunksToText()` TypeScript renderer and `GET .../chunks/:filename/text` REST endpoint with cache-first `.md` file caching. Both tools share an identical Markdown output format so whichever runs first primes the cache for the other. All 5 work packages completed across 18 total pipeline stages with 396+ test runs green; the Orchestrator Archaeologist persona was updated with concrete tool references replacing the former `(future)` placeholder. Key deferred items include frontend unit tests for `API.getChunkText()`, tab-bar interaction test coverage, and resolution of 107 pre-existing `API.getRepo` test failures.
project_summary: This project makes LangGraph agent dialogue readable without parsing raw JSONL by delivering two tools that share a common Markdown output format. A CLI extraction script reads chunk JSONL files and writes prose-only Markdown files alongside them, while a new GUI "Text Only" tab in the MCP Server dialogue modal lazily fetches extracted prose via a backend endpoint that caches the result as an .md file. The Orchestrator Archaeologist persona is updated to reference both tools.
